not_found: Absolute frequency of the 309.5 nm 1S0-3P0 clock line: no laser measurement located (only NIST Ritz level energies); no measured 3P0 lifetime (only '~2.5 mHz' in a level scheme).

Measured lifetime of 4s4p 3P1 with uncertainty and original citation: only 'tau ~ 26 us' (Waldherr et al. 2026) and theory-based 6 kHz / 4 kHz linewidth statements; the measurement of Byron et al. 1964 could not be opened.
Isotope-resolved absolute frequency of the 307.6 nm line: only the Doppler-broadened natural-mixture centre of Bueki et al. 2021.
1S0-3P2 (304 nm, M2) line: no measurement located.
Lifetimes of 4s4p 3P2, 4s5s 3S1 and 4s4d 3D1,2,3; A values for the 468.0 / 472.2 / 481.1 nm (3P-3S1) and 328.2 / 330.3 / 334.5 nm (3P-3D) lines beyond NIST ASD: no accessible source opened.
67Zn hyperfine constants of 4s4p 3P2 (Lurio 1962), 4s5s 3S1 and 4s4d 3D: not printed in any source opened.

Isotope shifts of the 481 nm 3P2-3S1 line (Campbell, Billowes, Grant): only mass-scaled values inside a global fit are printed in Sahoo & Ohayon, Phys. Rev. Research 5, 043142 (2023); raw MHz values not located.
Measured Lande g factors: none beyond the values already in the NIST ASD levels file.
conflicts: 67Zn 4s4p 3P1 hyperfine constants: A = 608.922(3), B = -18.995(10) MHz (Waldherr et al. 2026, laser fluorescence) vs A = 609.086(1), B = -18.782(8) MHz (Byron et al. 1964, double resonance); the F=5/2-3/2 interval differs by 0.77 MHz, reason unknown.
307.6 nm isotope shifts: new kHz-level values vs Campbell et al.: 68-64 1362.390(3) vs 1365.2(1.4) MHz and 70-64 1958.358(7) vs 1962.2(1.7) MHz (2 sigma).
67Zn 1P1 magnetic hyperfine constant: 20(2) MHz (Roeser 2024) vs 17.7(5) MHz (Kowalski & Traeger).
213.9 nm natural linewidth: 110.5(1.4) MHz measured (tau = 1.440(18) ns) vs 114 MHz from the NIST A value (7.14e8 s^-1, tau = 1.40 ns) vs 71 MHz quoted by Bandarupally et al. 2023.
307.6 nm linewidth: 6 kHz (theory, quoted by Bueki 2021 and Moeller 2025; tau ~ 26 us) vs 4 kHz (Bandarupally 2023); the task brief assumed ~4 kHz.
notes: Conventions. (1) Isotope-shift keys 'a-b' mean nu(a) - nu(b), all relative to 64Zn as printed; 67Zn values are hyperfine centres of gravity. (2) Fields beyond SCHEMA.md: natural_linewidth_*, photoionization, top-level 'rydberg' (ionization limit) and 'conflicts'. (3) rme_J_ea0 values are derived here from lifetimes (schema convention, branching to the ground state taken as 1); the 307.6 nm one rests on an approximate, uncited lifetime. (4) The 307.6 nm frequency_THz is a natural-mixture Doppler centre and is flagged 'not verified' in its source string so that the pipeline ignores it. (5) Zinc has far less modern laser-spectroscopy data than Cd or Hg: only the two ground-state lines have been measured with lasers.
